title: Favorites email test
description: Test the template in the current page language using your saved tours and packages. Each language is sent once to the approved test address. This does not change reminder language or turn on reminders.
accepted: This language’s test email has been accepted. It is sent only once; check your inbox, Promotions and spam folders.
failed: The test email could not be sent. Check that you are using the approved test account.
unknown: The sending result could not be confirmed. Check your inbox before trying again.
expired: This test has expired. A new authorized test is needed.
localeUnavailable: This test window uses another language. A new authorized test is needed for the selected language.
